player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Chopsticks. On your turn, choose one of:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=your hand (0 or 1), O=opponent hand (0 or 1).
    - Opponent's hand count increases by your hand; if >=5, it becomes 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  to redistribute your total fingers into L and R (L+R = your total).
Reply with exactly one of those commands.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Letsoho la mohanyetsi {opp_idx} le se le shoele.
invalid_move.split_sum: Ho aroloa ho tlameha hore e be {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Split must change your hand distribution.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Tšeo di sa hlakahlisitswe. Sebelisa “[attack M O]” kapa “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} e tšosa letsoho la P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: le fihla ho tloha {opp_val} go ya {new_val}.

outcome.draw: Moeli oa ho fetoha o fihlile.
